title: Formula H by Blazer_mk1
author: Bhumph_
selftext:
I have been wanting a hoverboard type game for a long time. but, no one is making one so i went ahead and started it. this is an early prototype. I want to get a gauge of what people think. Its still a little clunky, but the bones are good for development. Play as olive in formula H over on my patreon. Its free! Also on free on [itch.io](http://itch.io)  
  
Please give me your suggestions, thought, what you hate about, what you would like to improve. there is a list but, I would like the communities feedback. 

  
[itch.io/formula-h](https://blazer-mk1.itch.io/formula-h)
